Weed in East & West Village

The East and West Village together have seven licensed dispensaries and about 2,400 products, the most shops of any Manhattan neighborhood below 14th Street. Gotham on the Bowery, The Flowery's East Village store on 10th Street and PRYZM on Avenue B each list around 500 products, and The Flowery's West Village store on Christopher Street is close behind. Dagmar on Jane Street, Smacked on Bleecker and Sky High Club on Avenue C are smaller, more focused shops.

Pre-rolls dominate the combined menu at 754 listings, with 611 edibles, 478 vapes and 469 flower options, plus 78 concentrates. The Flowery's two stores and Gotham Bowery carry the widest brand lists, while Dagmar is the pick for Ruby Farms pre-rolls and Smacked for Plug Play pods. Prices start at $5 for 1906 drops and single-serve drinks at most of the larger shops. Because the stores are spread from the Hudson to Avenue C, the right choice depends mostly on which side of Broadway you are on.

Good to know
  • Seven licensed shops: three around 500 products each on the east side, one on Christopher Street, and three smaller stores.
  • Pre-rolls (754) are the largest category, then edibles (611), vapes (478) and flower (469).
  • Gotham Bowery and The Flowery East Village are the deepest menus east of Broadway; The Flowery West Village is the deepest west.
  • Entry prices run $5 to $6 for drinks and drops, except Sky High Club where the floor is $15.
East & West Village FAQ
Which Village dispensary is the largest?

Gotham on the Bowery, at about 545 products, with The Flowery East Village and PRYZM both just over 500. The three are within a ten-minute walk of each other in the East Village.

Is there a licensed dispensary in the West Village?

Two. The Flowery on Christopher Street has about 480 products and is the larger. Dagmar on Jane Street has about 175, mostly pre-rolls, and is the westernmost shop in the neighborhood.

Where can I smoke after buying in the Village?

Not inside any dispensary, and not in Washington Square or Tompkins Square, which are parks. Smoking is allowed on sidewalks where tobacco is allowed. Edibles and drinks avoid the question.
